description: BICEP/Keck BK18 band-average bandpasses: BICEP3 at 95 GHz and the Keck Array at 95, 150 and 220 GHz, from the collaboration's June 2021 data release (BICEP/Keck XIII), converted from frequency to wavelength.
short_description: BICEP/Keck BK18 bandpasses: BICEP3 95 GHz, Keck 95/150/220 GHz
facility_description: BICEP/Keck is a series of CMB polarization experiments at the South Pole (BICEP1-3, Keck Array, BICEP Array).

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the LAMBDA product page or in the files.
licence.scope: NASA LAMBDA distribution of a collaboration data release; LAMBDA's About page states no data terms. Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: Column 2 ('response to a source with uniform spectra radiance', Planck RIMO convention) is used. BK18_220 column 2 peaks at 0.01281 although the header says 'peak-normalized' (column 3 peaks at 1): scaled to peak 1 here. DetectorType energy assumed.
